program.title: Exos Aerospace × Montana Spaceport
program.headline: Fly with Exos now → Fly from Montana next
program.summary: Exos and the Montana Spaceport signed a Letter of Intent on February 26, 2026. Montana payload customers can fly on the Exos BLK3 reusable suborbital vehicle in 2027 from Exos's current launch site, then follow the vehicle to Montana once the Montana spaceport is licensed and operating. The Montana spaceport is PLANNED and in development; it is not yet licensed or operational.
